result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the bottom navigation is visually broken by a thick black bar overlapping its icons.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is obscured by an abnormally thick black horizontal bar that overlaps and covers the middle navigation icons, making them unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Add proper safe-area padding above the system gesture indicator, restore the system indicator to its normal thin size, and ensure all bottom navigation icons are fully visible and tappable above it.
